notes.title: The Arcade Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

We are commited to making heavy machinery do weird things, and in this update we introduce The Arcade

We have created two new minigames that will challenge your skill with the articulated arm. You will find them in the Overworld map, just look for geodesic structures!

A-1: Punching balls
If it is lighted on, punch it! It is that easy. You have two and a half minutes to punch as many balls as you can.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34905249/4ff0e0c70fcd34c4555c45443b7b2d6526bccb35.jpg


A-2: Roll-a-ball
Use the arm to hit balls into holes: Green holes give you 1 point, blue 2 points, and yellow, 3 points. The red hole gives 5 points, but it is particularly difficult to hit. This game is all about precision!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34905249/54a89455bdce67d9600ce9b9ae495d4a6084e1e7.jpg


Other changes in 1.1
More music: A new spiffy track by enveloop.

Better 4k support: All user interface elements have been updated with high resolution assets for a perfect visualization on 4k displays.

Performance improvements: We have made several small performance improvements that contribute to a smoother experience, especially on lower-end machines.

New cooperative map: We have redesigned the cooperative overworld to give you access to all levels from the same map, making it easier to navigate. You can unlock the different areas by beating the single player levels, and collecting the hidden miniature diggers.

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34905249/d6738cd525cca2bf23fcdafb452b5ef7eb516547.png
The waiting has ended, BH Trials is here!
No transmission, no steering and no brakes? No problem!

Take advantage of the launch discount and the OST bundle.

We hope you enjoy the game.
The BH Trials team.
